title: Account Balances
description: Every open asset account with its balance in its own currency. Investment accounts are valued at market price.

widgets.title: Account Balances
widgets.helpText: Balance of each open asset account on the selected date, in the account's own currency, grouped by currency with totals at every level. Investment accounts show market value: units held × the latest price on or before that date (cost when there is no price). Click a row to see its transactions. To show a friendlier name, add display-name to the account's open directive.

steps.query: WITH open_accts AS ( SELECT name, metadata_json FROM accounts WHERE name LIKE 'Assets:%' AND open_date <= :asOf AND (close_date IS NULL OR close_date > :asOf) ), cash AS ( SELECT p.account, p.currency, SUM(CAST(p.amount AS REAL)) AS value FROM postings p JOIN commodities c ON c.code = p.currency AND c.is_currency = 1 WHERE p.account_type = 'Assets' AND p.transaction_date <= :asOf GROUP BY p.account, p.currency ), held AS ( SELECT p.account, p.currency AS holding, p.cost_currency AS currency, SUM(CAST(p.amount AS REAL)) AS units, SUM(CAST(p.amount AS REAL) * COALESCE(CAST(p.cost_amount AS REAL), 0)) AS cost_basis FROM postings p JOIN commodities c ON c.code = p.currency AND c.is_currency = 0 WHERE p.account_type = 'Assets' AND p.transaction_date <= :asOf AND p.cost_currency IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.account, p.currency, p.cost_currency ), px AS ( SELECT base_currency, quote_currency, CAST(quote_number AS REAL) AS price FROM ( SELECT base_currency, quote_currency, quote_number, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY base_currency, quote_currency ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC) AS rn FROM prices WHERE date <= :asOf ) WHERE rn = 1 ), holdings AS ( SELECT h.account, h.currency, SUM(CASE WHEN px.price IS NOT NULL THEN h.units * px.price ELSE h.cost_basis END) AS value FROM held h LEFT JOIN px ON px.base_currency = h.holding AND px.quote_currency = h.currency WHERE ABS(h.units) > 0.000001 GROUP BY h.account, h.currency ) SELECT v.account, v.currency, ROUND(SUM(v.value), 2) AS balance, json_extract(o.metadata_json, '$."display-name"') AS display_name FROM (SELECT * FROM cash UNION ALL SELECT * FROM holdings) v JOIN open_accts o ON o.name = v.account GROUP BY v.account, v.currency HAVING ROUND(SUM(v.value), 2) != 0 ORDER BY v.currency, v.account
